topic: Role of heat energy in phase changes
key_concepts: Heat is the transfer of energy from a warmer object to a cooler object.
Temperature measures how hot or cold something is.
Particles are tiny pieces of matter that make up all substances.
Adding heat increases particle motion and temperature.
Removing heat slows particles and decreases temperature.
During a phase change, temperature stays constant while heat changes the state.
Melting and evaporation require heat to be absorbed.
The water cycle involves phase changes driven by heat.
Global warming melts glacial ice and raises sea level.
